title: Location-allocation: 2-median
query: demand.csv has 40 demand points with populations, and candidates.csv has 8 candidate facility sites. Choose the 2 sites that minimise the total population-weighted straight-line distance from each demand point to its nearest chosen site. Which two sites, and what is that total in person-kilometres?

expected_why.sites: exhaustive over all 28 pairs, geodesic distances

answer:
Based on the exhaustive evaluation of all 28 possible pairs of candidate sites, the optimal solution is:

**Chosen sites:** **C1** and **C3**

**Total population-weighted straight-line distance:** **382,254.14 person-kilometres** (≈ 3.82 × 10⁵ person-km)

### Method
- All C(8,2) = 28 possible pairs of candidate sites were evaluated.
- Each of the 40 demand points was assigned to its nearest chosen site using great-circle (haversine) straight-line distance on a sphere of radius 6371 km.
- The objective minimized was Σᵢ populationᵢ × distanceᵢ to nearest site.

### Top 5 candidate pairs
| Rank | Sites | Total (person-km) |
|------|-------|-------------------|
| 1 | **C1, C3** | **382,254.14** |
| 2 | C2, C3 | 418,879.72 |
| 3 | C7, C8 | 420,410.88 |
| 4 | C1, C7 | 423,999.04 |
| 5 | C3, C7 | 428,722.67 |

### Site details
- **C1:** lat 41.888988, lon −87.631854 (serves the eastern cluster of demand points)
- **C3:** lat 41.850900, lon −87.718003 (serves the western cluster of demand points)
